resources.string: A single finger sliding 48 dp switches to touch control; lift and swipe again if needed. A pen stroke switches back to writing. Finger drawing is suspended in this mode. Enable this app’s accessibility service. Compatibility varies by device and system version.
Auto mode requires Android 14 or newer. Manual switching remains available.
Accessibility service connected. Auto mode is ready.
Auto mode is waiting for its accessibility service. Until enabled, use the mode button.

Optional automatic switching for DrawAnywhere. While its toolbar is running in auto mode, this service receives pen events so the first stroke can return to writing. It does not read screen contents. Finger scrolling uses normal system touch input.
The system denied a required permission. Allow display over other apps and background operation in app settings, then try again.
This device does not provide a required system interface. Check the Android version and app permissions. Copy the details below when reporting this problem.
The app could not read or save its settings. Check available storage and copy the details below. Your settings have not been reset.
The system could not create or update the drawing window. Check overlay permission and restart the app. Copy the details below if the problem continues.
The system could not start the drawing service. Open the app from its icon and allow background operation. Copy the details below if the problem continues.
Drawing stopped. Open DrawAnywhere to view the error details.
This application needs overlay permission to place the canvas on top of other apps.
